streaming_input.text: First, remove the loose mat and add night-lights along the bedroom-to-b
athroom route. Then use a nonslip tub surface and have properly anchored grab bars
installed; the nearby towel rack is not a safe support.
First explain that 911 is for real police, fire, or medical
emergencies. Practice only with a powered-off phone. Teach him to say what happened
, state the emergency's location, answer questions, follow instructions, and stay on
the line. I cannot detect his location, so teach him his home address for
emergencies there. If he dials accidentally, stay connected and explain.
